messages.content: Great, let's start with some IEEE-style requirement gathering for your task manager app—no technical knowledge needed. I'll ask a few questions to clarify your needs.

analysis_summary: We're building a task management app to help users organize their work. Let's clarify a few details to ensure we build exactly what you need.

question_plan.summary: We're building a task management app to help users organize their work. Let's clarify a few details to ensure we build exactly what you need.

questions.question: Who will be using this app most often?
What are the most important things people should be able to do in the first version?
questions.placeholder: Example: create tasks, set due dates, mark tasks as complete, organize by projects

questions.question: Where do you want people to use this app first?
How should users sign in to access their tasks?
What kind of reminders or updates should the app send to users?
questions.placeholder: Example: task due date reminders, daily task summaries, completion notifications

questions.question: Are there any privacy or data protection rules we need to follow?
About how many users do you expect to have when you launch?
Does it need to connect with any other tools or services?
questions.placeholder: Example: payment service, email, SMS, calendar, WhatsApp, ERP.

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Task Manager application, providing a complete specification for development, testing, and implementation.

product_scope.summary: A web-based task management system that enables users to organize projects, track tasks, collaborate with team members, and generate structured documentation through AI-assisted workflows.
business_objectives: Provide a centralized platform for task and project management
Enable efficient team collaboration and workflow automation
Reduce project planning time through AI-assisted requirements gathering
Ensure data integrity and security for all project information
benefits: Improved project visibility and tracking capabilities
Enhanced collaboration and communication among team members
goals: Deliver a fully functional task management system within 6 months
Achieve 99% system availability during business hours
Support concurrent access for up to 1000 users
Maintain response times under 2 seconds for critical operations

product_perspective.system_context: The Task Manager application operates as a web-based service with a responsive frontend, RESTful API backend, database persistence, and integration capabilities with external systems. The system supports multiple user roles and provides real-time collaboration features.

related_systems.interface_summary: External cloud storage for document attachments and file management with secure access controls

related_systems.interface_summary: Integration with email and messaging platforms for task notifications and alerts

functional_requirements.title: Project Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow authorized users to create new projects with basic metadata including title, description, start date, and end date
acceptance_criteria: Projects can be created with required fields populated
Project creation includes validation of date ranges
Unique project identifiers are automatically generated

functional_requirements.title: Project Editing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow project managers to modify project details and metadata throughout the project lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: All editable fields can be modified by authorized users
Changes are logged in audit trail
Concurrent edits are handled with conflict resolution

description_and_priority.description: Complete task lifecycle management including creation, assignment, tracking, and completion

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Task Creation and Assignment
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support creating tasks with detailed descriptions, deadlines, and assigned team members
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be created with all required metadata
Tasks can be assigned to specific team members
Assignment notifications are sent to recipients

functional_requirements.title: Task Progress Tracking
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide mechanisms for tracking task progress including status updates and completion percentages
acceptance_criteria: Progress can be updated by assigned team members
Status changes trigger appropriate notifications
Progress history is maintained and visible

description_and_priority.description: Intelligent requirements gathering and documentation generation through guided interviews

functional_requirements.title: Guided Interview Process
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide an interactive interview process to gather project requirements through structured questions
acceptance_criteria: Interview questions are contextually relevant
Answers are captured and stored persistently
Interview progress can be saved and resumed

functional_requirements.title: Document Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate structured requirements documentation in multiple formats based on interview responses
acceptance_criteria: Documents are generated in requested formats (JSON, PDF)
Generated content is accurate and complete
Documents include proper formatting and branding

description_and_priority.description: Comprehensive reporting capabilities for project performance and team productivity

stimulus_response_sequences.system_response: The system processes the request and shows a clear status update.
postconditions: The updated result is available for review.

functional_requirements.title: Custom Report Generation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create custom reports with flexible filtering and formatting options
acceptance_criteria: Reports can be filtered by multiple criteria
Custom date ranges are supported
Report templates can be saved for reuse

functional_requirements.title: Performance Dashboards
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide interactive dashboards showing key performance indicators and metrics
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards display real-time data
Metrics are configurable and customizable
Visualizations are clear and informative

performance_requirements.description: The system shall respond to user interactions within 2 seconds under normal load conditions
Database queries shall complete within 500 milliseconds for 95% of requests
The application shall support concurrent access by 1000 users without degradation
File uploads and downloads shall maintain throughput of at least 10 Mbps per user
System availability shall be 99.9% during business hours (8 AM - 6 PM local time)

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: All user authentication shall use multi-factor authentication with OAuth2 protocol
Data transmission shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher
Role-based access control shall enforce least privilege principles
Sensitive data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption
Audit logs shall record all significant system events and user actions
Regular security vulnerability scans shall be performed and addressed promptly

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Projects must have a unique name within the organization
Tasks cannot be deleted once marked as completed
User roles determine access to specific project features and data
Project deadlines cannot be set in the past during creation
All system-generated documents must include version information
Email notifications must include opt-out mechanisms where appropriate

database_requirements.description: The database shall support ACID transactions for data integrity
Data retention policies shall comply with organizational requirements (minimum 7 years)
Database backups shall occur daily with point-in-time recovery capability
The database shall support horizontal scaling for increased load capacity
Data migration scripts shall be provided for schema changes
Query performance shall be monitored and optimized regularly

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with GDPR requirements for data protection and privacy
All user data handling shall follow organizational privacy policies
Export controls shall prevent unauthorized data transfer across jurisdictions
Intellectual property rights for generated content shall be clearly defined
Service level agreements shall meet organizational compliance standards

reuse_objectives.description: Reuse question planning, validation, and export modules across future agents.

additional_requirements.description: The system shall provide comprehensive API documentation for integration purposes
User training materials and help documentation shall be available online
The application shall support keyboard navigation and screen readers for accessibility
Mobile responsive design shall support devices from 320px width upwards
System shall include comprehensive monitoring and alerting capabilities
All external integrations shall include fallback mechanisms for service outages
